sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:18

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:18:1
items.html:
The abundance of light in that place causes an illumination to be extended and expand downward: Meaning, it has been explained that all four posteriors of AVI and YESHSUT, and all seven lights from the seven kings, all of them rose as MAN [Mayin Nukvin] to the forehead. It has also been explained that at first the coupling was made upon the screen only at the level of Malchut, which is called Ibur [impregnation], as above, so that by this only a very small portion was corrected out of the whole of the MAN that rose there, namely only the discernments of NHY in each of the Partzufim of Atzilut. Accordingly, most of the MAN remained there with no correction at all, that is, all these four levels of Rosh and Guf that are included in the posterior of the upper AVI together with the four lights of DHGT [Daat, Hesed, Gevura and Tifferet], and the four levels of Rosh and Guf that are included in the posterior of YESHSUT together with the four lights of NHYM — all of these remained there without correction.
And this is what he says, “The abundance of light in that place causes an illumination to be extended and expand downward,” for through this they became MAN for the upper AB and SAG, as is written further along: that through this coupling from the illumination of AB, the bottom Hey descends from the place of the forehead to the place of the Peh [mouth], and then the coupling is made upon the bottom Hey that is in the place of the Peh, and the level of Keter of MA comes out upon her. And this is the discernment of the male of Atik, that is, the first level of the new MA.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:18:2
items.html:
And this light that came out from the forehead expanded from there downward: For this new light, which came out from the coupling of AB and SAG, expanded and came to the first Rosh [head] of Nekudim, which stands from the Tabur of AK upward, and from it to the Rosh of Atik, which stands in the place of the GAR [first three] of Nekudim. And the Rosh of Atik came out from the place of the Peh [mouth] of Nekudim upward, until the Tabur of AK, and the ten Sefirot of the Guf [body] from the Peh of Nekudim downward, until the end of Atzilut.
And we must understand well this change here from the preceding Partzufim. For in all the preceding Partzufim, the ascent of the screen after the completion of its refinement was to the Rosh of its own upper Partzuf, that is, to its root. Here, however, the screen rose to the upper one of its upper one, for the upper one of the new MA is the Partzuf of Nekudim, and it should have risen to the Peh of the GAR of Nekudim and not to AB and SAG, which are the upper Partzuf of Nekudim. Indeed, the ARI has already explained this matter above (page 601, item 4), where he gives the reason: it is because the GAR of Nekudim themselves are not corrected, and therefore the raising of MAN was to AB and SAG. See there. And although the GAR of Nekudim were not broken, and even the cancellation of the posterior does not touch them at all, since they are only discernments of addition from what they received through the illumination of the NHY of AK — indeed their own discernment, that is, all that came out from the beginning of their emanation, was not cancelled from them even in the least, as is known — even so, since the screen and all the records in it rose to them, their ascent caused in them a discernment of the revelation of a deficiency. For the entire matter of the correction of the GAR of Nekudim was by force of back to back, that is, the discernment of the slight illumination that they received from the light of the Ozen [ear]. (As above, page 489, the passage beginning “And one should not ask.” And study well page 498, the passage beginning “And it has been explained.”) For through the illumination of the posterior of Bina they are not flawed at all by the bottom Hey in the Einayim, which is found in the Keter of Nekudim above them and which withholds from them the illumination of Hochma; for without her too they would not receive Hochma, because of the illumination of Bina that is in them, which does not desire Hochma but only the light of Hassadim, in the secret of “for He delights in mercy.” Study it there well.
And therefore, after the screen and these records came up to them — since all these records are discernments of ZON that need the illumination of Hochma, and the illumination of Hochma had already been in them, for even the four posteriors of AVI and YESHSUT are likewise the records from the levels that came out upon the MAN of the Yesod of AK, which is called Vav and a point, which are discernments of ZON, as is known — then Ima of Nekudim was compelled to stop her discernment of posterior, and she could not do so because of the bottom Hey above her. Therefore the deficiency was revealed, owing to the restriction of Hochma by force of the bottom Hey that is upon her; and once the deficiency was revealed, they too must rise as MAN to their upper one in order to receive correction.
And therefore the GAR of Nekudim had to rise, together with the screen and the records, to the Rosh of their upper one, which is the Rosh of SAG of AK, and they all became a discernment of MAN for the Rosh of SAG. At first the screen was included in the coupling of the Rosh of SAG itself, and by this it thickened no more than the discernment of the coarseness in the Keter of the screen, because the last phase that the screen had in the Partzuf of Nekudim is phase one, and it is known that the last phase is always lost by the force of the refinement that has passed. It turns out that the screen can now thicken only in the discernment of the root, which is the discernment of the coarseness of Keter. Therefore it is regarded that the screen of the Rosh of SAG rose, for the sake of this coupling, to the discernment of its forehead, that is, to the Galgalta, which is the Keter of the Rosh — for the forehead is a part of the Galgalta, but its discernment of Bina. And the upper light coupled with the screen, and ten Sefirot at the level of Malchut came out upon it; for although the bottom Hey is included in this screen as well, still, since she stands in Keter, only the coarseness of Keter can be revealed in her, and that brings out only the level of Malchut. And you already know that this coupling is called the discernment of Ibur, and that it has three lines that are called NHY.
However, it was not yet completed with this, for in this coupling only the smallest portion of the records in the screen was corrected, and therefore there was still a great pressure there from the abundance of light of all the records that need correction. And it is known that the records of ZON have a great connection with the discernment of Bina, which is SAG, in order to receive from her the discernment of the illumination of Hochma, by force of the connection of Bina and ZON of the direct light. Therefore it rose as MAN a second time to SAG of AK, and then the Rosh of SAG turned its face to the Mochin within it, that is, the discernment of HGT of AB that are clothed in its Rosh in the discernments of Mochin and Neshama, and AB and SAG were found coupling. And the new light that comes out of this coupling, when it reaches the Rosh of SAG, lowers the bottom Hey that had risen there to the forehead, for the lights of AB are always whole and no breaking applies to them; and therefore it lowered the bottom Hey to the place of the Peh, that is, to the place of the coupling that applies in AB itself. And once the bottom Hey came to her place in the Peh, the screen received from her phase four
of clothing and phase three of the coarseness in her, and then the upper light that coupled with the screen brought out ten Sefirot at the level of Keter. And this level came out upon the screen and the records that are now included in the Rosh of SAG itself. From there the screen descended to the place of the Tabur of AK, that is, to the lower one of SAG, and there too those same ten Sefirot at the level of Keter came out, which is the discernment of the first Rosh of Nekudim. And from there the screen descended to the place of the Peh of Nekudim, and there too ten Sefirot at the level of Keter came out, and these ten Sefirot are the discernment of the Rosh of Atik, the male. And from the Peh of Nekudim downward the ten Sefirot of the Guf expanded from above downward, and they are called the ZAT of Atik.
And in truth the screen should have descended to the place of the Chazeh [chest] of Nekudim, for there is its true root, since this screen was from the discernment of the Guf of Nekudim, that is, from the expansion of the seven kings. However, since the GAR of Nekudim needed it, because they receive the level of Keter from it, they therefore hold it in their own place. And moreover, it is reckoned as their male. (A note in the author’s own handwriting: And this requires examination. It is more correct that Atik clothes the Guf of the first Rosh of Nekudim, for Atik is the first Rosh of Atzilut. And one may further resolve that although in practice the GAR of Nekudim stand below the Tabur of AK because of phase four that became mixed in them, still, in principle they clothe from the Peh of the Rosh of SAG downward, and Atzilut is below the Tabur of SAG.) And this is because it bestows upon them the GAR that they lack from the beginning of their emanation, as explained.
